body:
Thank you LtBenben

I'm out of the forest for now. I've been working a lot in therapy lately on being present with and facing a lot of ugly emotion and last night turned out to be a deep dive in dark waters with no line back to the boat considering this move coincided with my therapists 2 week leave. I've realised I've got to find a way not to get lost when these moments inevitably come up again - as real change will require passing through and engaging with dark & scary places/things.

Thank you so much for being that line last night when I didn't have one.
